desc: Identify viable approaches and the need for combinatorial \(O(W+H)\) boundary sums.

Derive a complete first-hit boundary formula: count all paths in the full grid, subtract paths starting in the hole and paths whose unique first entry into the hole is through its left or bottom boundary; express each factor and all needed sums in \(O(W+H)\), including degenerate boundary-touching cases.
Prove that the first-hit decomposition is disjoint and exhaustive.
Implement modular combinatorics and the derived formula as a Python stdin/stdout solution.
